actions.description: What the panel offers, in order. Each action can carry its own input fields.
actions.title: Panel actions

behavior.description: A popover under the tray icon for delegating a task or firing a quick action.
behavior.leftClickHint: Right-click always opens the tray menu.

leftClickOptions.toggle-window: Shows or hides the main window

behavior.previewHint: Opens the panel where the tray icon last was.
behavior.title: Tray quick panel

desktopOnly: The tray quick panel is only available in the desktop build.

editor.description: Choose when the action is offered, what it does, and which inputs it collects.
editor.fieldsHint: Collected before the action runs; reference them as '{{fieldId}}'.

issues.emptyEffect: Fill in what this action should do.
issues.emptySelect: Dropdown "{id}" needs at least one option.
issues.illegalTrigger: Only "open a page" and "run a command" may run when the panel opens.
issues.invalidFieldId: Field id "{id}" may only use letters, digits, - and _.

editor.label: Label
editor.targetHint: newSession, activeSession, or '{{fieldId}}' to let an input decide.
editor.title: Edit action
editor.whenHint: Optional. The action is hidden unless the expression is true.

fieldEditor.empty: No input fields — the action runs straight away.
fieldEditor.label: Label

layout.autofocus: Focus the delegate box on open
layout.autofocusHint: Start typing a task as soon as the panel opens.
layout.description: How big the panel is and which data it shows. Changes repaint an open panel right away.
layout.maxHeightHint: The panel grows with its content up to this height, then scrolls. You can also drag the panel's bottom edge.
layout.scopeHint: Which data the modules count. The panel header switches this too.
layout.title: Panel layout
layout.widthHint: Modules rearrange themselves to fit the width.

modules.delegateHint: Hidden, the delegate action moves into the quick actions.
modules.description: Which modules the panel shows, in what order and size. The preview updates as you edit.
modules.title: Modules
modules.copyPhoneHint: Use the modules, order and sizes of your phone's Glance here. Pins and shortcuts stay on the phone.
modules.copyPhoneNone: Available once a paired phone has saved its own Glance layout.
